title: The sign of the times
content: I have had dreams ‘end of world’ where the sky transforms into purple/black clouds with a huge black void, and/or this ussaly involves mass panic and people being carpeted into plane like spaceships that take us all somewhere else. I don’t know if this is that right path if we follow or stay. I’ve had both play out and neither seem too good. Last night I saw the mass black out as the city flickered, turned off, and I knew this was it. I knew it was the 3 days of darkness and I told whoever was with me ‘is here’ and to run. We were in a huge group of people running towards the mall I told my people to hide. Then I could get back to sleep enough to continue the dream . There’s too much happening right now in the world to ignore. Too many signs too many coincidences. And with the death of Pope Francis. What does this all mean for us mall worldians. Are we the ones who are ment to recognise and remember what we need to do. Will we just ‘know’ when and as it happens? I feel as if we are right on the edge
